name: nl.jsplinter/jsplinter
title: Jonas Splinter (jsplinter.nl)
description: Jonas Splinter: profile, projects, updates, blog, tech timeline and calendar. Read-only, no sign-in.

tools.name: about
tools.description: Who Jonas Splinter is: headline, short bio, current roles, skills, languages, contact details and the main links of jsplinter.nl. Start here for questions about the person; call list_projects for his businesses and side projects.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: The businesses and side projects of Jonas Splinter (Blockspot.io, VoucherAlarm, Automate & Tweak, JSplinter Games) with a one-line description, his role, the project website and its page on jsplinter.nl. Call get_project with a key for the details.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full details of one project: what it is, key figures with the month they were taken, what it offers, important pages, social channels, milestones, the technology where published, and the newest updates about it. Keys come from list_projects.

key.description: Project key as returned by list_projects, one of: blockspot, voucheralarm, automateandtweak, games. Example: "blockspot".

tools.name: search_updates
tools.description: Search the dated updates Jonas posts about what he is building. Matches any of the words in title, text, project and tags and ranks by how many match; without a query it returns the newest. Optional filters: project, tag, since. Each result has the full text (updates are short), tags and a URL; use get_update for one update by slug.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "astro rebuild" or "accessibility". Optional; leave out for the newest updates. Max 120 characters.

project.description: Optional project filter: jsplinter, personal, blockspot, voucheralarm, automateandtweak, games. ("jsplinter" = the site itself, "personal" = personal notes.)

tag.description: Optional tag key as returned by list_tags, e.g. "claude-code".

tools.name: get_update
tools.description: One update in full by its slug: date, project, title, text, tags, its URL on jsplinter.nl and the link it points to, if any. Slugs come from search_updates.

slug.description: Update slug as returned by search_updates, e.g. "site-redesign".

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: The longer blog articles on jsplinter.nl, newest first, each with date, summary, tags, reading time and URL (plus an audio version, when the post has one). Optional: words to look for (any word may match) and a tag filter. Call get_post with a slug for the full text.

query.description: Optional words to look for in title, summary and text, e.g. "mcp server". Max 120 characters.

tag.description: Optional tag key as returned by list_tags, e.g. "mcp".

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: One blog article in full as Markdown, with its date, summary, tags and URL, and an audio field (MP3 URL, duration, chapters with start times) when the post has a narrated version read by an AI voice. Slugs come from list_posts.

slug.description: Post slug as returned by list_posts.

tools.name: list_tips
tools.description: The practical tips from the blog: one short step per post that a reader can act on today, with the post it comes from (title, URL, tags) and which one is today's "tip of the day" (it comes first). Optional tag filter. All tips on one page: https://jsplinter.nl/tips/

tag.description: Optional tag key as returned by list_tags, e.g. "cloudflare".

tools.name: list_followups
tools.description: Checks Jonas planned after a post or update went out (for example comparing a post with a release that came later): title, what will be checked, the post or update it is about, due time, status (open, done or dropped) and the outcome once done. Open ones first, by due time.

status.description: Optional filter: open, done, dropped or all (default all).

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: The technologies and topics the updates are tagged with (for example Astro, Laravel, Claude Code, AI, SEO), each with a one-line introduction, the number of updates and its page on jsplinter.nl. Use a key as the tag filter of search_updates.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: The browser arcade games in JSplinter Games with a one-line description, the URL to play and the current top score on each leaderboard.

tools.name: timeline
tools.description: Every technology Jonas has used since 1990, from the technology timeline on jsplinter.nl: each row with its slug, name, kind, topic group, start and end (to = null: still in use), tag, a short note, what replaced it (a slug) and its own page /timeline/<slug>/ (get_technology returns that page in full). Newest start first. Optional filters: query, group, in_use. Without filters the turning points (the key moments) come too. The same data as JSON: https://jsplinter.nl/myapi/timeline.php

query.description: Optional text to find in the name, kind or note (part of a word is enough, case does not matter), e.g. "linux". Max 120 characters.

group.description: Optional topic group, as on the filter buttons of /timeline/: systems, internet, network, gaming, storage, voice, tts, chat, calls, social, phones, navigation, web, cloud, automation, home, analytics, work, tools, ai.

in_use.description: Optional: true = only what is still in use, false = only what was phased out.

tools.name: get_technology
tools.description: One technology from the timeline in full, as its page /timeline/<slug>/ shows it: when Jonas used it (period, in use or phased out), the longer text when there is one, world facts (introduced, maker, discontinued), what it replaced and what replaced it, the blog posts and updates about it, the games it inspired, and its release, support and end-of-life dates from the tech calendar. Those posts and updates are already included, so there is no need to call search_updates or list_posts for the same technology. Find slugs with timeline (query), or pass a name such as "Laravel".

slug.description: Row slug as returned by timeline, e.g. "laravel". A name such as "Laravel" (any case) also works. Max 80 characters.

tools.name: calendar
tools.description: Dated events from the tech calendar on jsplinter.nl: release days, support changes and end-of-life dates for the technology on Jonas's timeline (whole product lines: every PHP, Python, Ubuntu LTS, Laravel and Windows version), plus his own milestones (started or stopped using something) and blog posts. Each event has a date (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD), kind, title, the technology, its page, a source for world dates, and how far from today. Use around for "what just happened / what is next"; otherwise filter by words, kind and period (oldest first). Page: https://jsplinter.nl/calendar/ ; JSON: https://jsplinter.nl/myapi/calendar.php

around.description: Optional: return the N latest past and N next upcoming events (other filters except kind are ignored).

query.description: Optional words that must all appear in the title, technology or topic, e.g. "php end of life" or "windows 11". Max 120 characters.

kind.description: Optional: release, support (a support phase ends), eol (end of life), mine (Jonas started/stopped using it) or post (blog post).

from.description: Optional earliest date: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, or "today".

to.description: Optional latest date: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, or "today".

tools.name: list_mcp_servers
tools.description: Other MCP servers run by Jonas Splinter, with what each one is for, when to suggest it and how to connect (for example the Automate & Tweak directory of AI tools). Call this when the user needs something this server does not have.
